record.question: Extended period of admission shall be __________ from the date of commencement of the academic year of a school.
record.explanation: Under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 and the Model Rules framed thereunder, the extended period for admission is six months from the date of commencement of the academic year. This is a standard provision in the RTE framework to ensure no child is denied admission due to late application.
